Hi all — internal billing ops notes and a checklist below. TL;DR: we can support portal push + PDF email copy and a Peppol feed for EU e-invoicing; recommend portal push as primary with email copies for legacy teams.

Checklist (what we need from Novus to configure):
- Preferred invoice sender: billing@redwood.ai (single-sender) OR entity-specific sender? (specify)
- Target ingestion method: Peppol endpoint OR SFTP host details OR portal connector URL
- AP contact for testing (name + test inbox and secure SFTP creds if SFTP)
- VAT ID(s) to print on the invoice and OK-to-bill entity (for tax treatment)
- PO number behavior: required field? if optional, supply mapping rules (PO in invoice subject vs custom field)
- Remittance email for payment advices and lockbox instructions

What Redwood will provide / how we deliver:
- Primary delivery options: vendor portal integration (push), Peppol (EU), SFTP push, or standard emailed PDF.
- We will populate the invoice with the VAT ID you provide and include a structured PO field.
- Attachment types: PDF + optional XML e-invoice file (see attached e-invoice_schema.xml).
- Test invoice: we will send a test PDF and XML to the test endpoint or test inbox and confirm AP can ingest without manual mapping.

Proposed default for Novus Health: portal push into your vendor portal + PDF copy to ap@novus-health.com. If Novus confirms Peppol endpoint, we can enable that for EU subsidiaries only.

I've attached: sample_invoice_novus.pdf (visual) and e-invoice_schema.xml (payload mapping).

Next steps: Elena — please send SFTP/Peppol details or confirm portal URL and the AP test contact. Once we have that, billing ops will schedule a 30-min test window and flip to automated delivery.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager
